start.text: Oh! You must be the new neighbor. I'm Maya. Welcome to the building!

choices.text: Thanks! I'm just getting settled in.
Hey. Nice place you've got here.

friendly.text: If you ever need anything, my door is always open. I bake cookies on weekends!

choices.text: Good to know. See you around.

flirt.text: Hehe, you're smooth. I like that. Maybe we should get to know each other better?

cold.text: Oh... okay. Well, the offer stands if you change your mind.

cookies.text: It's a date! Come by Saturday afternoon. I'll make extra.

hangout.text: I'd really like that. How about my place tonight? I have wine...

choices.text: Maybe another time. I'm busy tonight.

coffee.text: Coffee it is. There's a cafe downstairs. Tomorrow morning?

choices.text: Actually, let's skip to the wine.

tease.text: Hehe, you're bold. Let's just say... I'm open to whatever feels right.

choices.text: Then let's find out what feels right. (Start intimate scene)
I like the sound of that. Tomorrow?

intimate_offer.text: I've been wanting to get closer to you. Come in... let's see where this goes.
